# Boardchestrator

The operating system for your agents — a self-hosted agent workspace with boards, autonomous agents, a versioned wiki, and MCP tool integration.

## Docs

- Concepts: Boards, agents, wiki, and MCP — how the pieces fit together. (https://thomasteoh.github.io/boardchestrator/concepts/)
- Deployment: Docker, environment reference, and operations for running Boardchestrator in production. (https://thomasteoh.github.io/boardchestrator/deployment/)
- Documentation: Getting started, usage, and deployment for Boardchestrator. (https://thomasteoh.github.io/boardchestrator/docs/)
- Getting started: Install, configure, and run Boardchestrator locally or in production. (https://thomasteoh.github.io/boardchestrator/getting-started/)

Source: https://github.com/thomasteoh/boardchestrator
